proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: Treat two staged documents as one for the gate when their in-scope renders match except for marks that carry no identity, revision or decision fact (for example a company seal, or an export difference), and both carry the same field truths. Count the pair once, on the lower id, as for byte-identical files, and keep both label sets. When one copy adds a field fact (a consultant stamp, review code or mark-up decision) or carries a different revision, they are separate documents.

proposed_convention_rulings.topic: (d)/(e) decision class follows the printed legend; class of code D
proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: Rule the class from the printed option text or legend beside the ticked letter, not from the letter alone. Where the form's or stamp's legend prints D as 'Not Approved' (or 'Rejected'), D is class 'rejected', as the frozen conventions list it. A layout helper's mapping of D to 'revise and resubmit' must not override a printed 'Not Approved'. Only where a printed legend defines D as a resubmission does D become revise and resubmit, with a note. On the AREX SDAR/MAR forms, A - Approved = approved, B - Approved as noted = approved as noted, C - Revise & Resubmit = revise and resubmit, D - Not Approved = rejected. On the AREX review stamp, 'C Incorporate Comments & Resubmit' = revise and resubmit.
proposed_convention_rulings.evidence: The option rows on F039-p1, F040-p1 and F072-p1 print 'A - Approved', 'B - Approved as noted', 'C - Revise & Resubmit' and 'D - Not Approved'. The AREX stamps on F039-p2 and F040-p2 print 'D Not Approved', and the review tables print 'D-Not Approved'. No D decision is ticked in this batch.

proposed_convention_rulings.topic: (g) revision only as a suffix (here: a suffix of an enclosed drawing's description, not of the own number)
proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: When an approval-request or transmittal form has no revision cell and '-R0' style text ends the description of the enclosed drawing (not the form's own reference number), record it as present, semantic role 'suffix of the enclosed drawing's description line', association uncertain with a note. It does not make the document's revision unresolved when an in-scope page of the same document carries the enclosed drawing's own revision cell with a consistent value. It counts toward the population only through that resolved page.
proposed_convention_rulings.evidence: F039-p1 reads 'FA-6001 SCHEMATIC DIAGRAM FIRE ALARM LAYOUT-R0' and F040-p1 reads 'EM-104 SCHEMATIC DIAGRAM EM LIGHT LAYOUT-R0'. The p2 title blocks of both documents read 'REV - 0'.
